patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: It came out of nowhere — sudden, severe pain low on my right side, and I threw up from how bad it is. It comes in these awful waves.
presentation.triageNote: 22-year-old female with sudden severe right-sided pelvic pain that comes in waves, repeated vomiting, and marked right adnexal tenderness. She is tachycardic and rates the pain 9/10.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 2 is appropriate because sudden severe unilateral pelvic pain with vomiting is a time-sensitive high-risk presentation.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This young adult has abrupt episodic right-sided pelvic pain, repeated vomiting, marked adnexal tenderness, tachycardia, and pain rated 9 out of 10.
clinical.acuityReason: The presentation may reflect threatened ovarian blood flow and requires rapid gynecologic evaluation even with stable blood pressure.
redFlags: Sudden unilateral pelvic pain with vomiting
teachingPoints: Normal or intermittently preserved Doppler flow does not fully exclude torsion when the clinical pattern is strong.
Definitive treatment should not be delayed when ovarian viability is threatened.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Urgent imaging and gynecologic assessment would likely lead to operative detorsion if torsion remains suspected.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: doubled over, clutching her lower right abdomen
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: an asian 22-year-old woman, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: doubled over, both hands clutching her lower right abdomen. Expression: grimacing and nauseated. Clearly visible: a doubled-over posture with hands pressed to the lower abdomen. No text, no logos.
